_note: Internal control for Run 4 (not for the report): Run 4 (supcon_ce_convnext_base_heldout_pairs) with the SupCon loss weights set to 0, so only the cross-entropy heads and the calibrated pair-level held-out pairs loss train the model. Since Run 3 the pair score comes from the cross-entropy heads, and the SupCon embeddings only shape the backbone features, so this run shows whether the contrastive term adds anything. One change from Run 4; the data, two-view batches, optimiser, schedule, validation protocol and gamma/epoch selection are identical. Stage 1 is re-run in full because the training loss changed.
_result: Internal control (not for the report). Test HM Top-1 70.71 / Top-5 93.16; seen 63.20, unseen 80.25; raw seen 73.2, raw unseen 11.5; 21.1% of seen images sent to unseen pairs. Epoch 17, gamma 7.25, validation HM 61.73 (per split 58.43 / 60.54 / 66.22). Versus Run 4 (SupCon on): 70.94 / 92.97, validation 61.27, same epoch and gamma. A difference of 0.2 on test and 0.5 on validation is far inside the noise of about 3 points: the SupCon term adds no measurable value; the gains of Run 4 come from the cross-entropy heads and the held-out pairs loss.

model._note: ConvNeXt-Base from timm, ImageNet-22k pretraining then 1k fine-tuning; drop_path_rate is stochastic depth. ce_dropout matches the baseline's head dropout.

input._note: Bicubic resizing, as ConvNeXt was pretrained.

augmentation._note: Same as the independent ConvNeXt-Base baseline.

loss._note: CHANGED from Run 4: SupCon weights 0 (the SupCon term is still computed but has no gradient). Cross-entropy and the pair loss unchanged.

scoring._note: CHANGED: mode heads, the cross-entropy heads' log-probabilities. temperature is only used for the prototypes saved alongside.

optimizer._note: As the independent ConvNeXt-Base baseline (lr_head also covers the projection and cross-entropy heads).

training._note: final_schedule match_validation as in Run 2. No saved validation grid is reused: stage 1 runs in full because the training loss changed.

runtime._note: grad_checkpointing: recompute backbone activations in the backward pass; identical gradients, less GPU memory, somewhat slower. Needed because ConvNeXt-Base with 128 views per step did not fit in 16 GB.
